summary: Retest of the minor fixes from iteration_remove_subheadings_pdf_logo_jan2026. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. Staffing endpoints now return 401 without auth or with a bad token, 200 with the ops token, and the CRM-token fallback returns 200. Frontend: at 390x844 the warranty cards fit the viewport (right edge 374, no horizontal scroll), and the renewal nudge reads 'out of warranty cover' when all at-risk units are expired. In the Staff Portal the bottom-nav More label shows the active More-sheet tab and shows 'More' on the primary tabs. Some items were checked by reading the code only (see verified_by_code_review).
verified_passing: GET /api/staffing/compliance and /api/staffing/shifts: no auth gives 401, a garbage Bearer token gives 401, the portal@pulsefitness.ltd token gives 200
CRM token (POST /api/crm/auth/login owner@isodemo.com) on GET /api/staffing/shifts gives 200 (fallback works)

MOD Test Site /pulse?tab=warranties at 390x844: 8 cards, max card right edge 374 (<=390), document scrollWidth 390, warranty-download-certificate present as the first child (no empty spacer), nudge text '7 units are out of warranty cover' with counts 1 active / 0 expiring / 7 expired

Staff Portal vc.driver at 390x844: label is 'More' on home; More-sheet tabs rota, help and documents set the label to 'My Rota', 'Help & Tutorials' and 'Documents', and the sheet closes after selection; the primary tabs home, mytime, vehicle and holidays set it back to 'More'; the deep link ?tab=access gives 'System Access'; no horizontal overflow
verified_by_code_review: CustomerWarrantiesTab 'nearing the end of warranty cover' wording when any unit is expiring: no test data has expiring units. The logic atRisk.every(expired) ? out_of_cover : nearing is correct
CustomerWarrantiesTab with no items: the download wrapper only renders when items.length > 0, so there is no spacer

CustomerCertificatesTab: the next-due wrapper only renders when data.next_service_due is set, so there is no empty row. The cert-next-due 'Next service due' block is kept. No test org has certificates, so this could not be checked in the UI
critical_code_review_comments: On mobile the cookie consent banner covers the Staff Portal bottom nav until it is dismissed. This is expected consent UX but worth noting
dual_auth: if a platform token is invalid and the CRM fallback also fails, get_crm_user raises the 401, which is correct

success_rate.frontend: 100% of UI-testable items (the expiring wording and certificates checked by code review only)
